answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 8057 Country: United Kingdom Title: Q-Is it true that it is Makrooh Tahrimi to enter a church or a Jewish place of worship and other religions places since this is where the shayateen stay, this is according to Albahr Araiq for Ibn Nujaym, can we go in without a very strong overwhelming reason? Is it true that it is Makrooh Tahrimi? Question: Q-Is it true that it is Makrooh Tahrimi to enter a church or a Jewish place of worship and other religions places since this is where the shayateen stay, this is according to Albahr Araiq for Ibn Nujaym, can we go in without a very strong overwhelming reason? Is it true that it is Makrooh Tahrimi? Answer ID: 8057 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1076/1076=M/1429) Yes, it is right that going into church or a temple of Jews or any religion is makrooh tahrimi (undesirable to an extent of haram ). One must avoid going to such places: و فی الھندیۃ عن التتمۃ: یکرہ للمسلم الدخول فی البیعۃ والکنیسۃ، وانما یکرہ من حیث انہ مجمع الشیاطین لا من حیث انہ لیس لہ حق الدخول۔ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
